description:
### ✨ Overview

This mod is a black and white, L9 themed skin for Akshan. Were you naughty on the chat? Did you get punished? Don't lose yourself in despair, even the hopeless can get a cool skin sometimes...

#

### ✨ Additional information

The mod replaces the Base Akshan skin.

#

### ✨ Features

* Modified textures
* Modified loadingscreen
* Modified in-game HUD icons
* Modified VFX
